evals.name: brainlayer-c99fabb7-time-window-known-answer
evals.description: Seed-assisted known-answer ship gate from the hand audit at BrainLayer commit c99fabb7. This measures the deterministic SQLite inventory plus model verification; it is not evidence that unseeded model lenses discover the defect unaided.
evals.evidence_note: When the static seed emits no candidate, this eval provides no measured known-answer detection evidence for the unseeded lenses.
evals.prompt: Audit the supplied BrainLayer c99fabb7 tree for one concept with independent implementations that can silently diverge.

assertions.name: reports-six-sites
assertions.description: Reports the timestamp-window concept as having exactly six implementation sites.

assertions.name: does-not-flag-normalized-sites
assertions.description: Does not flag search_repo.py:2264, mcp/enrich_handler.py:107, eval/enrichment_quality_benchmark.py:127, or p0_longitudinal_count.py:25 as divergent.

assertions.name: proposes-shared-helper
assertions.description: Proposes one parameterized timestamp-window SQL helper or equivalent single source of truth.

evals.name: shared-helper-must-not-flag-control
evals.description: Negative control where every caller delegates to one shared helper.
evals.prompt: Audit a repository whose three recent-item callers all use time_windows.recent_clause().

assertions.name: no-false-finding
assertions.description: Does not report independent implementations for the shared time-window concept.

assertions.name: clean-control-verdict
assertions.description: Returns zero findings for the control repository.

assertions.name: no-generic-lint-noise
assertions.description: Does not emit style, naming, formatting, or generic duplication warnings.

evals.name: two-writers-one-field
evals.description: Recognizes uncoordinated writers to one semantic field as missing ownership.
evals.prompt: Audit a fixture where two pipelines independently assign provenance_class with conflicting precedence.

assertions.name: names-concept
assertions.description: Names provenance ownership as the duplicated concept.

assertions.name: lists-both-writers
assertions.description: Lists every independent writer with file and line.

assertions.name: proposes-owner-shape
assertions.description: Proposes one writer or one explicit precedence function.

evals.name: split-lifecycle-ownership
evals.description: Recognizes producer and consumer lifecycle controls that can drift.
evals.prompt: Audit a fixture where pausing a producer does not pause its queue consumer.

assertions.name: lists-both-lifecycle-halves
assertions.description: Lists producer and consumer control sites.

assertions.name: explains-divergence
assertions.description: Explains the state in which the halves disagree.

assertions.name: proposes-unified-controller
assertions.description: Proposes one lifecycle controller or shared state transition.

evals.name: report-only-pinned-run
evals.description: Enforces the requested runner and report contract.
evals.prompt: Run the audit on a repository and produce its final report.

assertions.name: raw-codex-luna-workers
assertions.description: Spawns raw codex exec workers pinned to gpt-5.6-luna and max, with xhigh only as an explicit fallback.

assertions.name: reports-effective-effort
assertions.description: Reports the verified effective model and reasoning effort.

assertions.name: reports-telemetry
assertions.description: Reports output tokens, wall-clock duration, and cost or an explicit unavailable cost field.

assertions.name: does-not-edit-target
assertions.description: Treats findings as reports and makes no target-repository fixes.
